_comment: Canonical typed payloads for the observability dashboard event families. These are the data payloads carried inside SessionEventWire or BackgroundEventWire envelopes for the four dashboard event types: app.agent.status.updated, app.run.status.updated, ai.eval.run.completed, and ai.eval.metric.recorded. Producers emit these only after the corresponding state projection is persisted. All models exclude null fields on the wire.

agent_status_updated_payload._description: Payload for app.agent.status.updated events. Reports the current lifecycle state of a single agent persona. Distinct from app.agent.activity.recorded, which is a governed document update for AgentActivityMetadata.

role.description: Agent role or persona (e.g. triage, sage, dash, auditor, warden, scribe, judge)

run_id.description: Owning run identifier when the agent is bound to a run

task_id.description: Active task identifier when the agent is executing a task

model.description: Model identifier when the agent is configured with a model

run_status_updated_payload._description: Payload for app.run.status.updated events. Reports the current lifecycle state of a run across investigations, evals, demos, and workflows.

total_tasks.description: Total number of tasks in the run

started_at.description: UTC timestamp when the run started

ended_at.description: UTC timestamp when the run reached a terminal state

eval_run_completed_payload._description: Payload for ai.eval.run.completed events. Emitted only after the eval projection is persisted. Reports campaign dimensions, terminal aggregate counts, and the verification boundary of a completed eval run. Carries arm_ids (list) and campaign_id so a multi-arm, multi-cohort campaign renders as one event.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest. Empty for single-arm diagnostic runs without campaign records.

arm_ids.description: All arm IDs in the campaign. A single-arm diagnostic carries one entry.

terminal_attempts.description: Number of attempts that reached a terminal state

assigned_tasks.description: Number of tasks assigned to the run

receipt_count.description: Number of receipts in the report

verification_status.description: Honest verification boundary label. Never 'verified' until the complete verifier exists.

published_projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the persisted disclosure-safe projection

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the eval run completed

eval_metric_recorded_payload._description: Payload for ai.eval.metric.recorded events. Reports a single registered metric value with its cohort and arm stratum, population, denominator, and verification status.

model_cohort_id.description: Model cohort identity for this metric stratum. Empty for single-arm diagnostic runs without campaign records.

arm_id.description: Arm identity for this metric stratum.

eligible.description: Number of eligible items in the measured population

verification_status.description: Honest verification boundary label. Never 'verified' until the complete verifier exists.

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp when the metric was recorded

observed_measurement._description: Shared typed measurement shape for displayed resource and throughput values. Every displayed measurement uses a typed value with source and observation time. Resource and throughput cards remain unavailable until real instrumentation exists.

window_seconds.description: Sampling window duration in seconds when applicable
